about.title: Calm, clear and individual care.
about.paragraphOne: Hijama is a traditional form of cupping that many people include in their personal wellbeing routine.
about.paragraphTwo: At Hixhame Tina, every session is designed exclusively for women, with careful attention to privacy, hygiene and clear communication.

benefits.title: Wellbeing topics, discussed with care.
benefits.introduction: The topics below reflect common reasons people explore hijama; they are not promises of results. Hijama does not replace medical assessment, diagnosis or treatment.

items.title: A sense of lightness and wellbeing
items.description: Some people include hijama in their routine as a moment of intentional self-care.

items.title: General wellbeing
items.description: Some people view it as one part of a mindful personal wellbeing routine.

items.title: Relaxation and rest
items.description: The calm setting of a session may provide a moment to pause, rest and unwind.

items.title: Tension around the head and neck
items.description: Some people explore hijama when they feel tense. Persistent or severe symptoms should be discussed with a qualified healthcare professional.

items.title: Comfort for the back
items.description: Some people include it in a broader wellbeing routine focused on comfort around the back.

items.title: Stress and tiredness
items.description: A session in a calm setting may offer a moment away from a demanding daily pace.

items.title: Sinus discomfort
items.description: Some people explore hijama during periods of discomfort. Persistent symptoms should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.

items.title: Women's wellbeing
items.description: Every session is organized with particular attention to women's comfort and privacy.

items.title: Rheumatic discomfort
items.description: Hijama should not replace usual care or treatment recommended by a qualified healthcare professional.

items.title: Sciatic nerve area
items.description: Persistent pain, numbness or weakness should be assessed by a qualified healthcare professional.

benefits.disclaimer: Experiences vary from person to person. If you have symptoms, a health condition or take medication, speak with a qualified healthcare professional before booking.

faq.title: Clarity before you book.
faq.actionPrompt: Didn't find the answer you need? Message us directly.
faq.whatsappMessage: Hello, I would like to ask a question about Hixhame Tina.

items.question: Is the service exclusively for women?
items.answer: Yes. Hixhame Tina is a space dedicated exclusively to women.

items.question: How can I book an appointment?
items.answer: You can call us or message us on WhatsApp. Together, we will find an appointment that suits you.

items.question: Where are you located?
items.answer: We are in Kolovicë, Prishtina. We confirm the appointment details during booking.

items.question: How long can a session take?
items.answer: The duration may vary depending on the session and will be confirmed when you book.

items.question: How should I prepare?
items.answer: You can message us with any questions before your appointment. We will provide the necessary guidance clearly.

items.question: Can I ask questions before booking?
items.answer: Always. Message us on WhatsApp or call us, with no pressure to book.

booking.title: Reserve a moment just for yourself.
booking.description: For questions or bookings, contact us directly by phone or WhatsApp.

footer.disclaimer: The information on this website is general and does not replace advice, diagnosis or treatment from a qualified healthcare professional. Individual experiences may vary.
